column1: # psd_op: the pseudo-code operation of a psd record (psd.op). shcgen writes the .sua records shcpep reads, so the
# numbering is shcpep's, named as shcpep's own debug dump names them (its opcode name table at 00426c68); every
# value needs a member, or the decompiler spells an unnamed one as an expression of others.
# il_op: the operator of a node of the .ilb tree (gen_node.op): the IL shcmdl writes, named as shcmdl's tree
# dump names them (its lowercase name table at 00434668); values without a name there are IL_NON_xx.
